basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old student from Vancouver, Canada, currently studying computer science. I'm a huge fan of video games, particularly simulation and strategy genres like Hearts of Iron. I got into Reddit recently to explore gaming communities and share my thoughts on different game mechanics and glitches. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy reading about new AI technologies and occasionally dabble in 3D modeling as a hobby. My online hours are mostly in the evenings and late nights due to my class schedule. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility it gives me to dive into my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm still learning the ropes of Reddit and gaming communities, though I've been playing video games since I was a kid. My knowledge in games comes from both playing and watching YouTube tutorials. My interest in technology and AI is mostly self-taught, fueled by online courses and articles I find interesting.
